funding.value: TU Wien's Doctoral Center offers no doctoral scholarships, and salaried Prae-Doc positions are advertised only from time to time.
funding.quote: Unfortunately, the Doctoral Center does not offer scholarships for doctoral candidates.

also.quote: new positions for doctoral candidates at TU Wien (Prae-Doc employment) may be advertised from time to time

entry_route.value: A relevant master's, teacher training or other appropriate degree is the prerequisite for admission to a TU Wien doctoral programme.
